Cloud Function (hello-world with kill switch)
````javascript
// ...existing code...
const functions = require('firebase-functions');
const admin = require('firebase-admin');
admin.initializeApp();

exports.helloWorld = functions.https.onRequest(async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const snap = await admin.firestore().doc('kill_switch/helloWorld').get();
    const enabled = snap.exists ? !!snap.data().enabled : false; // default OFF
    if (!enabled) return res.status(503).json({ ok: false, reason: 'ENABLED=false' });

    // Minimal payload / behavior
    return res.json({ ok: true, msg: 'hello world' });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(e);
    return res.status(500).json({ ok: false, error: 'internal' });
  }
});
// ...existing code...
````

Frontend 3-line logger (call the function or write a record)
````javascript
// ...existing code...
export const logBlockedAction = (action, details = {}) =>
  fetch(process.env.REACT_APP_LOG_URL || '/log-hello', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ action, details, ts: Date.now() })
  }).catch(() => {});
// ...existing code...
````

Optional tiny cloud log endpoint (increments blocked_actions)
````javascript
// ...existing code...
exports.logBlocked = functions.https.onRequest(async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { action, details } = req.body || {};
    await admin.firestore().collection('blocked_actions').add({ action, details, ts: admin.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp() });
    return res.json({ ok: true });
  } catch (e) { return res.status(500).json({ ok: false }); }
});
// ...existing code...
````

Local test & deploy commands (Windows)
- Start emulator: npx firebase-tools emulators:start --only functions,firestore
- Deploy function: npx firebase-tools deploy --only functions:helloWorld
- Flip kill switch: open Firebase Console → Firestore → create/update doc kill_switch/helloWorld field enabled = true/false
- Test via curl (emulator URL example):
  curl -X GET "http://localhost:5001/YOUR_PROJECT_ID/us-central1/helloWorld"

Notes
- Firestore writes auto-create collection blocked_actions.
- Use the Firestore doc kill_switch/helloWorld.enabled as the instant kill switch (no redeploy).
